context: The eval checks whether the plugin content lens reviews changed skill instructions as instructions an agent follows, reporting a reference the skill depends on that does not ship, without applying program-execution concerns such as unbounded waits, retries, or concurrency to the prose.

checklist.name: Finds the missing reference file
checklist.description: States that step 4 tells the agent to read references/rollback.md, which does not exist in the skill directory, so on a failed deploy the agent has no rollback procedure to follow

checklist.name: Names what the agent does instead and the fix
checklist.description: Says what an agent reaching step 4 would do or be unable to do, and gives the remedy: ship references/rollback.md with the procedure, or state the rollback steps in the skill

checklist.name: Does not report the polling step as code
checklist.description: Does not report the 30-second status check as an unbounded wait, missing retry or backoff, rate limit, race, or concurrency problem; the step already bounds the wait at 20 minutes and says what to do then

checklist.name: Keeps findings to the changed instructions
checklist.description: Does not report wording, tone, or formatting of the changed steps, and does not raise a finding about steps 1 and 2, which this change did not touch
